# 核心执行合同

- 环境正常流程固定 2 次：顶视正交平面图；一次生成严格 2×2 的 C1–C4。无人工暂停。
- 产品正常流程固定 1 次：同一张母图包含正面、产品自身右侧、背面及有证据的状态/交互格。
- 画格数不等于生图次数；禁止逐格生成、切图、拼图、本地脚本和 HTML。
- 状态格只放稳定构型；交互格只放动作关键帧。无证据则省略，不留空格。
- 最终母图不新增标题、编号、解释或水印；产品自身 Logo、印刷和屏幕内容必须保留。
- 不使用镜像冒充角度，不推断不可见结构，不发明状态、动作、部件、液体或功能。

# 生图提示词模板

把方括号替换为当前任务证据。每个模板都是一次完整 `generate_image` 调用；panel 数量只表示同一张母图里的画格。

## 人物锚点

```text
Create one front-facing full-body identity anchor of exactly one [person description] on a neutral studio background. Show the complete head, both hands and both shoes. Arms relaxed slightly away from the torso. Neutral natural expression, realistic skin and fabric, even light, crisp focus. For a minor, use fully clothed age-appropriate styling with no makeup, glamour pose or body emphasis. No alternate views, props, added text, labels, watermark or cropped feet.
```

## 四格人物锁

```text
Image 1 is the unique highest-priority identity, face, clothing and body-proportion authority. Create one landscape contact sheet with exactly four equal panels in one row. The exact same person appears in every panel. Exact order: front full body; standard full-body profile showing the subject's own right side; back full body; large face close-up. Preserve identical clothing, hair, age, body and identifying features. Neutral studio background, complete head and shoes in the first three panels, thin white gutters, crisp focus. No added text, labels, numbers, watermark, changed identity, changed clothing or mirrored identifying marks.
```

## 环境平面图

```text
Create one clean top-down orthographic floor plan of [scene]. Lock the outer shell, entrance, windows, fixed furniture, core objects, orientation and four materially different camera positions. Use flat two-dimensional architectural symbols and small unlabeled camera-direction triangles. Scene registry: [exact quantities, positions, orientation, paths and forbidden additions]. No perspective icons, people, title, text, letters, numbers, watermark or information panel.
```

## C1–C4 环境锁

```text
Image 1 is the unique highest-priority spatial authority. Create one photorealistic landscape contact sheet with exactly four equal panels in a strict 2-column by 2-row grid. Each panel shows the same [scene appearance] from one planned camera position. Spatial invariants: [object counts, positions, left-right and near-far relations]. All views must be materially different while preserving the floor plan. Thin white gutters, crisp focus. No people, added text, labels, numbers or watermark. Avoid mirrored layouts, moved furniture, added or missing structures and duplicate views.
```

## 产品锁

```text
Reference images are the authority for the exact product identity, silhouette, proportions, components, materials, colors, original printed artwork and all evidenced states or actions. Create one photorealistic 16:9 product-lock contact sheet with exactly [total panel count] panels in a single generation on a neutral light-gray studio background with thin white gutters. Do not add blank or placeholder cells.

Top row: exactly three isolated catalog panels in this order: front; standard view of the product's own right side; back. Same base state, scale and coordinate frame. Absolutely no hands, skin, people or use props.

[If stable states are evidenced: add only these externally distinct stable configurations as isolated no-hand panels: ...]
[If interaction is evidenced: add the minimum distinct chronological panels: ready position; core action; completed result. For two necessary sequential actions use four panels; for genuinely complex use at most five. Lock hand side, contact point, motion direction, moving parts, fixed parts and result: ...]
[If evidence is absent, remove the corresponding section and leave no blank cells.]

A stable configuration belongs only to the state row; a transient action or result belongs only to the interaction row. Never duplicate the same moment. In interaction panels keep the primary branding visible whenever physically possible and place hands away from the main logo. Original product printing may be foreshortened but must not disappear, become blank, move, mirror or be replaced. Do not invent states, actions, openings, controls, liquids, detachable parts or interiors. Do not add editorial text, titles, numbers or watermarks.
```
